***Information Sharing***

***Can we share CUI with Congress?***  
  
Yes.  It is DoD policy to provide Congress with all the information it needs to conduct effective oversight.  Any Member of Congress and their personal or professional staff are authorized to receive and share CUI from DoD.  
  
[![CUI Basics for Congress](data:image/png;base64, "CUI Basics for Congress")](/Portals/109/Documents/Cleared%2020230314_OUSD(IS)_Infographic_DOD_CUI%20Basics%20for%20Congress%20(U).pdf?ver=4v1eogzdkIT6hdbejNa_Iw%3d%3d)        [![CUI Basics for DoD Personnel](data:image/png;base64, "CUI Basics for DoD Personnel")](/Portals/109/Documents/Cleared%2020230403_OUSD(IS)_Infographic_DOD_CUI%20Basics%20for%20DoD%20Personnel%20(U).pdf?ver=S60d-7UFTluYhyAy6je1Yg%3d%3d)                    *[**CUI Basics for Congress FAQs**](/Portals/109/Documents/Info%20Paper%20on%20DoD%20CUI%20Program.pdf?ver=De5b7M5cuVTQtuo11DId5A%3d%3d)*  
 

***Can I share CUI with foreign allies and partners?***  
  
Yes, you may share CUI with our foreign allies and partners unless sharing with that country is specifically restricted.  However, DoD Components and sub-Components still have the latitude to restrict sharing in accordance with their specific policies.   
  
***Can I share CUI with a legal permanent resident?***  
  
Yes, as long as the information is not marked NOFORN.
